title: The Library
description: My very first fullstack web application that allows users to search for books within the warhammer 40k universe. It features a user-friendly interface and many tools, such as book rating, summaries and quote saving.

title: The Wild Oasis
description: A Fullstack web application from the Jonas Schmedtmann React course.  A made up hotel website where users can book a cabin, edit and delete their bookings.

title: What to Watch
description: A mobile app that allows users to search for movies and series and save them to their own custom lists. It also features an option to get suggested random movies, when one does not know what to watch.

title: Subscription Tracker
description: A subscription tracking API that allows users to track their subscriptions and payments. It has preventive measures against cached requests.

title: Mr Moolah
description: A Banking system for a fictional bank. With a backend built in Java, it provides many features one may see in their typical bank. Such as account creation, deposit and withdrawal, fraud detection, interest rates, loan applications and more.

title: Path of Irregulars - In Progress
description: A Fullstack gwent-like browser game, based of popular manwha 'Tower of God' (Credit to SIU and Webtoon!)
